text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Now, the Umamusume are all gearing up 
for their final spurt!! The sprint begins 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit...! My body feels so heavy... My 
legs are getting dragged down...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. is moving up!! She's making her 
charge from the back!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (She's... closing in on me!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In the lead is Mr. C.B.! Mr. C.B.! Across 
the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Dammit...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking the very first step toward the 
Triple Crown, Mr. C.B. is the victor!! She 
has conquered the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!! Here it comes, here it 
comeeees!! Mr. C.B. really is 
incredible!!"

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She did it, she did it, she did it...!! 
That final late surge was insane...!! She 
looked so cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Ace-chan... So close. Still, you were 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You really gave it your all out 
there...! Losing is a bummer, but— you 
were super cool!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... damn it...— I can't... catch 
my breath... and yet...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Look at her... standing there so full of 
confidence already...!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...She's on a whole other level. Are we 
really in the same Classic class...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Game one of our best-of-three... Looks 
like I take the first one.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Today's race was so thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the Japanese 
Derby. —Because next time, I won't lose 
either."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (What a... massive back...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit...! Stop shaking...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the Satsuki Sho made headlines 
as the brilliant first step in Mr. C.B.'s 
glorious career—"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“—The Satsuki Sho ended in an expected 
victory for Mr. C.B., but just what kind 
of race will the Japanese Derby turn out 
to be?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"C.B. remains the undisputed favorite. 
Even on a track that put her at a 
disadvantage during the Satsuki Sho, it 
didn't slow her down in the least."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what kind of race the Japan 
Derby turns out to be, I'm sure she will 
deliver a flawless performance. She has 
shown us that level of strength."

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
""With things turning out like this, will 
an Umamusume truly emerge who can stand 
against her?""

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
""In my view, Sheena Frejus is a strong 
contender. She hails from a lineage of 
Umamusume with proven success over long 
distances, inheriting both the talent and 
technique.""

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"‘As the distance increases from the Derby 
to the Kikuka Sho, her stability should 
only grow. The one who will truly become 
CB's rival is likely her—’"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Haha. You can't even remember my name. 
Well, I guess that's obvious...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...It's so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's not that no one's looking at me. It's 
that I myself...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel it trembling... with the fear 
that it might not beat C.B. next time 
either...!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"After crossing the finish line at the 
Satsuki Sho, CB looked so full of life. 
Even more so than before she ran...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She looked so enormous…… and so strong to 
me back then……――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And that was the first time... I ever felt 
scared.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And that... is so frustrating... 
dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list:
Even if you're scared, you haven't given 
up. Am I right?

Even if you're scared, you haven't given 
up. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable Mr. C.B. was, the 
fact remains that Katsuragi Ace boldly 
challenged her, and is ready to challenge 
her again next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Mr. C.B. gets stronger, then Katsuragi 
Ace just has to get stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s growth is certainly remarkable, 
but Katsuragi Ace's rate of growth leading 
up to the Satsuki Sho was surely even 
faster...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as Katsuragi Ace's spirit remains 
unbroken, there is always a chance for 
victory...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I believe in that―― even more than 
Katsuragi Ace does……!!"
choice_data_list: So let's win the Japan Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Standing in front of Katsuragi Ace, I 
clenched my fist tightly, just like she 
did.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you're seriously such an idiot 
sometimes...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that side of you is super cool, 
and you're so reliable...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to that, I can act like a total 
fool and fight with all I've got...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trembling or scared, it doesn't matter! 
All I gotta do is push past every bit of 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's—what an "ace" is all about!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right!! Aiming for the Japanese Derby, 
let's do this, let's do thiiis!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting our arms around each other's 
shoulders, we raised our fists to the sky. 
With our spirits fired up... we march 
forward to the next decisive battle, the 
Japanese Derby!
